metadata.description: The Bodoland Territorial Council (BTC) elections are scheduled for 22nd September, and the political dynamics in the region have taken a sharp turn. The ruling coalition partners – UPPL and BJP – have decided to part ways for this election, changing the political equations on the ground. The contest is now shaping up to be a direct battle between UPPL and BPF, the two dominant forces in Bodoland politics. In this crucial backdrop, sitting CEM Pramod Boro shares his perspective on the election, the breakup with BJP, and the road ahead for Bodoland.
